title: Simple Shotgun
description: A datapack that adds a simple, leightweight, and user-friendly shotgun! Recipes and instructions can be found in-game as well!
body:
### Instructions
- Once you have a shotgun, use right click to shoot it, and crouch to reload it.
- Each shot takes one cartridge.
- Shooting while reloading will extend the reload time.

When you use the datapack for the first time, you will see a message in chat telling you the datapack was installed successfully. If you're getting bored of the datapack, you can uninstall it easily using **/function shotgun:uninstall**

(Disclaimer: the shotgun model is not included.)
